objective: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.

description: Ah, you're in need of my latest project... the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!  Unfortunately I've run out of funds and manpower.
You're willing to help?  Excellent!  Our first task is to build a device to harvest the very fabric of death!  Building an ectoplasmic distiller won't be an easy task, <name>.
I'll need you to bring me an arcanite converter, some greater eternal essences and stonescale oil. I'll also need some volcanic ash from the lava pools in the Burning Steppes to build a filter.
progress: I understand the materials are a bit pricey... but I promise you every last one of them shall be necessary!
completion: These are precisely the materials I needed. Quite timely too, <name>!
In mere moments I will have your distiller ready to go! In the meantime, take this as a reward for aiding me in my project.
